Stops are log2 ratios of linear luminance; cell = the largest per-cell difference over the grid; chroma = the largest per-cell shift of log2 R/G plus log2 B/G. visitorOnly: absolute checks applied to the visitor sets only (a closet is black at the slot's fixed exposure). enforce false: reported as warnings, not failures. cameras: per-camera overrides, e.g. {"backGarden_1": {"absolute": {"hueFrac": 0.2}}}.
